name: The Prince of Miurna (deceased)
description: Eloped with the [[Sultana of Caryes]]; assassinated with her and [[Lost Heir|their young child]]. Now almost mythic across the [[Greater Lands]].

name: The Sultana of Caryes (deceased)
description: Heir to [[Caryes]] and, through her mother, to the [[faction/realm-aphemenosta|Rock of Aphemenosta]] and the [[Emirate of Ievure]]. Assassinated with the [[Prince of Miurna|Prince]] and [[Lost Heir|their child]].

name: The Lost Heir
description: The child of the [[Prince of Miurna|Prince]] and the [[Sultana of Caryes|Sultana]], whose body never turned up. A closely guarded rumour. Popular sentiment would likely drive the remaining states to federate under a true heir of the couple.

name: The Emir of Ievure
description: The [[Sultana of Caryes|Sultana]]'s younger brother; holds the [[Emirate of Ievure|Emirate]].

name: Incentus I, Lord of the Dells
description: His ideals and writings form a philosophical core of [[Order of the White Raven|White Raven]] philosophy and, in rare and illicit tomes, of thaumaturgy.
